reason: 该插件的核心用途是向 DSH 提供实时热点数据采集能力：通过 hot_trends 工具按指定来源抓取公开平台的热搜/榜单数据并在技能说明中引导调用；其实现依赖对外网公开接口的访问，风险主要集中在外部服务可用性和返回格式变化，而非本地文件或敏感权限操作。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 增加了可调用的热点采集工具与技能，可从微博、百度、B站、知乎、App Store、QQ 音乐等平台获取公开的实时热搜和榜单数据。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a DSH tool and skill for fetching real-time hot searches and ranking data from public sources such as Weibo, Baidu, Bilibili, Zhihu, App Store, and QQ Music.

reasons.code: Plugin exposes a hot_trends(source, limit?) tool for fetching real-time hot/trending lists from multiple public platforms.
Manifest declares a DSH bundle plugin (index.js entry, bundle patch), indicating runtime integration with platform tools/skills rather than internal system operations.
